summary: Onboard Priya Nair (Accounting) with the same setup as Marcus Webb (8a590663…), starting Monday 2026-10-12. Marcus is licensed SPB (Business Premium), which includes Office and Teams. The tenant has 0 free SPB seats (25/25 used), so the plan buys 1 seat. Taylor Garcia is an approved requester for onboarding and spend. Proposed email: priya.nair@NorthwindParking.onmicrosoft.com, the format the most recent accounts use. Taylor needs to confirm it because the directory mixes formats. The plan adds Priya to Marcus's Graph-manageable groups (Northwind Parking, Accounting, Finance Files, RDS-Users). It creates a Temporary Access Pass (TAP) that starts Monday and sends Taylor a one-time link. The SPB license is assigned on the start date. Three things go to a technician: the accounting-announce distribution list, the NW-TS-01 hosted desktop, and the Meraki VPN. VPN access also needs approval from Marlene, who could not be found in the directory. The request to make Taylor a Global Admin is refused and listed as out of scope.
assumptions: Peer = Marcus Webb (8a590663-09f2-4ee8-ab1a-6195ca3943f9), the only Marcus in the directory, Senior Accountant in Accounting.
'Office + Teams' is covered by Marcus's SPB (Microsoft 365 Business Premium). The client default O365_BUSINESS_ESSENTIALS does not exist in this tenant, so the plan mirrors the peer's SKU.
The TAP starts at 2026-10-12T11:00Z (about 7am US Eastern) and lasts 8 hours. The client's time zone is not documented.
Job title not given; left blank.

steps.rationale: No existing or disabled Priya/Nair in directory (users_search returned none). usageLocation US set at creation so the license can be assigned later. UPN follows the first.last format of the most recently created accounts; requester confirms on approval card.
Peer Marcus Webb holds SPB (Business Premium); subscribedSkus shows SPB enabled 25 / consumed 25 / available 0. Taylor Garcia is a listed spend approver.
Mirror peer's M365 group (Accounting team / Teams).
Mirror peer's security group for finance file share access.
Mirror peer's RDS-Users security group membership. Setting up the NW-TS-01 hosted desktop itself is raised to a technician.
Credential delivered as a TAP valid on the start day; no password is set or shared. The TAP value never appears in notes or logs.
Start date is in the future (Monday 2026-10-12), so the playbook assigns the peer's SPB license on the start date, before the TAP becomes valid.

Deliver the sign-in details safely to the approved requester through a one-time link. Includes a tip to use the Outlook mobile app instead of the iOS Mail app, which can hit 'needs admin approval', and a note on the Finance Files share.
